title: Animal Behavior Technician I
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Behavioral Technician I supports AbbVie’s Behavioral Management program (BMT). This role is responsible for operant conditioning, enrichment, behavioral monitoring, and positive reinforcement for research animals. Provides direction and support to Animal Care Technicians and other AbbVie employees who perform animal husbandry in accordance with the company animal enrichment program. Elevates any concerns or inconsistencies with animal behavior and the enrichment program to the appropriate authority (manager) for action.
Responsibilities
Assist with performing positive reinforcement training of animals. Communicates skills and enrichment program requirements amongst research groups and Comparative Medicine staff. These include but are not limited to those for behavior related tasks, enrichment, socialization, operant conditioning, chair training, pole and collar training, target training.
Assist with training of staff on standardization and continued productivity as related to operant conditioning and enrichment related strategies.
Enables higher performance by building and maintaining strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team.
Identifies potential improvements to the program; remains flexible, open to suggestions and experimentation for improvement on enrichment and operant conditioning related strategies. Embraces the ideas of others, nurtures innovation and assists with the progression of innovation to reality.
Assists with daily tasks associated with animal enrichment animal enrichment, such as scheduling, prep, distribution to animals, evaluation of effectiveness, and enrichment area/supply maintenance.
Assists with entry and upkeep of behavioral, training and enrichment forms/database(s); Maintains documentation of all animal trainings (timelines, progress, comments, concerns, etc.)
Works with moderate work direction, remains flexible, performs multiple projects simultaneously, meets deadlines, and maintains sanitation standards.
Assists with incorporating the 3R’s into the Behavioral Management program
Attends applicable training and workshops pertaining to lab animal enrichment/behavior; participates in on-site enrichment trainings and committees where required.
Provides animal husbandry duties as required; Required weekend husbandry (or animal enrichment/ operant conditioning) rotation commitment
High School/GED is required AND at least 3 years prior technical experience in laboratory animal science setting OR relevant degree in related discipline (biology, animal behavior, animal science, veterinary technology) with at least two years laboratory animal science experience.
At least two years of animal husbandry/enrichment/ behavior/ training experience.
Certification by the American Association for Laboratory Animal Science (AALAS) at the Assistant Laboratory Animal Technician (ALAT) level; eligibility for LAT certification
Knowledge of basic regulatory requirements.
Communication Skills – Ability to concisely communicate key issues to stakeholders.
Analytical Skills – Ability to assess issues that arise, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information as needed, and identify key issues that need to be addressed.
Computer Literacy – Basic competence of spreadsheets, word processing and email, and knowledge of computerized maintenance management systems and purchasing systems.

AbbVie Analytical Research & Development (Analytical R&D) is a global analytical scientific organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's pharmaceutical products.  Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of innovative small molecule medicines and spans from the selection of Discovery candidate molecules to Late Stage Clinical.  We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines.  Careers in AbbVie Analytical R&D provide unique opportunities to work with global and cross-functional teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.  We are looking for diverse candidates with strong scientific experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting and rewarding career opportunities for these candidates.

Can demonstrate experimental precision and strong data interpretation skills. They should possess understanding of core discipline and support early phase development of New Chemical Entities (NCEs) drug substance and drug product in both preclinical and clinical programs. Learn and understand new experimental techniques with a curiosity to apply them for unique project / assignment requirements.
Demonstrate skill in multiple techniques and appropriately modify protocols, as required, to suit the changing needs of research or development sciences.
Place data in proper scientific context by consulting and citing relevant literature.
Demonstrate technical proficiency in their field, preferentially in the analytical areas of quantitative and instrumental analysis.
Raises the bar and is never satisfied with the status quo.
Impact projects predominantly through lab and/or pilot plant based activities.
Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, appropriate handling of materials, controlled drug and radioactive compounds, and GxP compliance, where applicable.
Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, or equivalent education, with typically 3 or more years’ experience or Master’s Degree or equivalent education (no additional experience).
Theoretical and practical knowledge (in chromatography and / or spectroscopy is highly preferred) to carry out job function.
Builds strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team to enable higher performance.

Support research initiatives as requested by AbbVie R&D, Clinical Operations, and Medical Affairs Departments and physician-initiated projects including, but not limited to, site evaluation and identification, recruitment, investigator meetings, external expert identification, and external collaboration management.
Prepares marketplace in new therapeutic areas of interest, which includes creating awareness and relationships for AbbVie in the Medical community.

title: Principal Research Scientist I Data
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.
Key Responsibilities
Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.
Supervisory / Management Responsibilities
This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.
Key Competencies
Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.
Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.
Required Experience
8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.
Preferred Experience
Commercial analytics experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, APLD, or similar Rx, claims, and engagement data.
Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. AbbVie is seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our Analytics & AI organization and help advance the next generation of Copay Intelligence capabilities.
This role will focus on developing innovative machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that help identify complex reimbursement and affordability program dynamics, improve patient access insights, and drive more proactive decision-making across patient support programs.
The successful candidate will play a key role in building predictive intelligence products that leverage healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data to identify emerging opportunities, uncover hidden patterns, and generate actionable recommendations. These capabilities support a long-term strategy to enhance copay program intelligence, improve affordability insights, and strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Working closely with data engineering, business stakeholders, technology teams, and analytics partners, this individual will help transform large-scale healthcare data into scalable AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact.
What You'll Be Doing
The Senior Data Scientist will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of advanced analytics and AI solutions supporting AbbVie's Copay Intelligence initiatives. This individual will work on highly visible strategic programs focused on predictive intelligence, healthcare affordability analytics, patient access insights, and advanced machine learning applications. The role requires a combination of strong technical expertise, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex analytical findings into practical solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about solving challenging problems with data and enjoys working across the full lifecycle of AI and machine learning product development.
Core Responsibilities
AI & Machine Learning Development
Develop advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence models that support healthcare affordability and copay intelligence initiatives.
Build predictive models that identify patterns, risks, and opportunities from healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data.
Design scoring frameworks, recommendation engines, and decision-support systems that enable proactive business actions.
Evaluate and implement modern AI methodologies, including machine learning, deep learning, ensemble methods, graph analytics, and Generative AI approaches.
Continuously improve model performance through experimentation, feedback loops, and performance monitoring.
Advanced Analytics
Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to uncover actionable business insights.
Perform feature engineering, predictive modeling, forecasting, segmentation, optimization, and statistical analyses.
Assess and monitor model performance using both statistical and business outcome metrics.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Develop methodologies to measure business impact and return on investment for analytical solutions.
AI Product Development & Operationalization
Partner with data engineering and technology teams to deploy machine learning solutions into production environments.
Design scalable and maintainable machine learning workflows and pipelines.
Implement model monitoring, automated retraining, model governance, and performance management processes.
Support development of enterprise AI products that can be scaled across multiple business functions.
Ensure solutions adhere to organizational standards for quality, privacy, security, and compliance.
Collaboration & Leadership
Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI and advanced analytics can drive measurable value.
Serve as a subject matter expert in data science, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
Present findings, recommendations, and technical concepts to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the growth of the broader analytics community.
Stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in AI, machine learning, and healthcare analytics.
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) is preferred but not required.
Equivalent combinations of education, specialized training, and relevant professional experience will be considered.
6+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments.
Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience building predictive, classification, forecasting, recommendation, or optimization models.
Strong knowledge of statistics, experimentation, predictive modeling, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud-based environments.
Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, model monitoring, and production AI practices.
Experience using modern software development and version control practices.
Business & Leadership Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and practical application of AI technologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, payer, patient support, or market access data.
Experience developing AI-powered decision support systems.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, or other large-scale data environments.
Experience deploying Generative AI or Large Language Model solutions.

description:
About AbbVie

Trial Surveillance & Analytics (TSA) is a newly formed center of excellence in Data & AI Acceleration, part of AbbVie's Data and Statistical Sciences organization. Our mission is to transform how AbbVie conducts ongoing clinical trial surveillance — integrating trial data, analytics and AI so that study teams and patient safety colleagues see emerging safety and efficacy signals early, and can act on them with confidence. This is work upstream, inside ongoing clinical trials, where insight can still change decisions for the study and for patients.
The Senior Manager, Trial Surveillance & Analytics is a hands-on, full-stack data scientist who takes a surveillance question from intake to a working solution. You will work in a small team that owns a capability end to end — from the data, through the analysis, to the tool that study teams use — and you will own your solutions from problem statement to a working product that people use. The team is AI-native from day one: agentic coding and AI agents are part of how we work, with room to experiment and to scale what works. You will combine depth in one area (such as statistical programming and reporting, data integration, data visualization, data science and machine learning, or data and software engineering) with enough breadth across clinical data, analytics and AI to deliver on your own, with the support of the team. As an early member of a new center of excellence, you will help define how it works, the standards it sets and the capabilities it builds, partnering across Global Patient Safety, therapeutic area clinical development teams, Statistics, Statistical Programming and data engineering across the portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:
Frame surveillance problems with stakeholders before building: understand the decision to be supported, design for adoption, and iterate with users.
Design and build data pipelines and analysis-ready, integrated data on SDTM, ADaM and integrated databases to support safety and efficacy surveillance.
Lead blinded, standardized analytics across studies and compounds to detect emerging safety and efficacy signals early.
Deliver reporting — tables, listings and figures, safety reports and listings — and automate it wherever possible.
Develop applications, dashboards and self-service tools that study teams and patient safety colleagues use themselves; drive their adoption and measure their use.
Apply generative and agentic AI across the analysis workflow, build AI agents on the clinical data foundation, and measure the gain in time and quality.
Integrate clinical trial and real-world data where the science requires it, assessing comparability and data quality first.
Lead projects and small cross-functional pods; coach and mentor team members. May include indirect supervision of employees and contract staff.
Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate technical concepts and results clearly to non-technical audiences.
Ensure adherence to applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and functional quality standards.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS (with 8+ years of experience) or PhD (with 4+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, Machine learning and AI or a highly related field.
Experience may be in pharmaceutical, biotech, health technology or related industries.
Strong hands-on programming in R and Python, plus SQL and version control (e.g. Git), with a track record of writing production-quality code for end-to-end analytical pipelines.
Demonstrated experience applying generative or agentic AI to analytical or programming work, with measurable results.
Experience working with clinical trial data (e.g. CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and/or real-world data (e.g. EHR, claims, registries).
A track record of building analytical tools or solutions that were adopted and sustained by their users.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical and technical concepts in plain language and to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience designing and building agentic AI systems (e.g. multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval and evaluation), with a track record of solutions delivered and used in production.
Experience in clinical development, drug safety, pharmacovigilance, clinical trial monitoring or regulatory evidence generation.
Knowledge of clinical trial design and of methods for real-world evidence, such as cohort definition, confounding control and external comparators.
Experience building interactive visualizations and data apps with modern frameworks (e.g. Plotly / Dash, Streamlit, Shiny, React / D3) and deploying on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS).
Familiarity with SAS.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives; formal business or leadership training is a plus.
Publications, presentations or community leadership in data science, statistics or AI.

description:
Job Description
The Opportunity
Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up-and-coming AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices.
This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon-to-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands-on full-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production-quality code that holds up over time.
What you'll do
Own full-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web.
Contribute to the production buildout of the agent: translating prototype-quality capabilities into robust, scalable, maintainable systems that meet Adobe's quality and reliability bar for a large, diverse audience.
Drive hands-on implementation of high-leverage components — including model orchestration, tool use, multi-step task execution, context and memory management, and agent evaluation infrastructure.
Champion the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices — using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and emerging agentic development platforms to accelerate implementation, raise code quality, and fundamentally change how the team ships. Model new workflows where AI is a first-class collaborator in the development process.
Contribute to developer experience: tooling, local development loops, CI/CD ergonomics, and the scaffolding that lets a team move fast and confidently in a fast-moving AI product environment.
Stay current with the model capabilities ecosystem, evaluating new LLM approaches and frameworks, and contributing recommendations on when and how to adopt them.
Help build and maintain the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior — the evals, benchmarks, and systematic feedback loops that allow the team to measure progress and catch regressions as capabilities evolve.
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to translate product ambitions into technically grounded delivery — surfacing constraints early, proposing implementation options, and ensuring scope is set based on accurate technical understanding.
Collaborate across Adobe's platform, infrastructure, data, and security teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built on a foundation that supports guardrails, data protection, observability, and the operational requirements of a product at Adobe's scale.
Raise the bar for peers on the team by generating excellent code, driving high-signal code review processes, and sharing technical knowledge in agentic engineering.

Solid, hands-on experience with large language models — including practical fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation, and the operational realities of running LLM-backed systems in production.
Experience building and shipping agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration frameworks, memory and context persistence, and the failure modes that emerge at each layer.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and a track record of integrating these into real development workflows. Enthusiasm for pushing the boundary of what AI-augmented engineering can look like at the frontier.
Full-stack engineering depth sufficient to contribute across the agent's entire surface area — including backend services, client SDKs, and platform-specific integration patterns for Adobe's target platforms.
Strong engineering craft: readable, well-structured, production-quality code; opinionated views on testing, local dev ergonomics, and the scaffolding that helps a team stay productive as a codebase grows.
Clear communication skills — able to discuss technical tradeoffs with PM leads and senior technical stakeholders, flag issues early, and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the underlying models, frameworks, and user expectations are all rapidly evolving — strong enough foundations to move fast without building on sand.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, design, platform, and security teams in the context of shipping user-facing AI products.
Familiarity with the quality, trust, and reliability requirements of shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience, including responsible AI considerations specific to generative and agentic systems.

The Opportunity
Adobe is seeking an experienced risk and controls leader to join the Chief Accounting Office as Senior Manager, Risk & Controls. This role offers high visibility at the crossroads of finance transformation, technology, and compliance. As the embedded risk advisor to the Finance & Tech Transformation Office (FTTO), you will collaborate directly with teams driving product launches, process automation, system implementations, and large-scale business transformation initiatives. description:

The Community You Will Join:
When a significant severe safety incident impacts, or threatens to impact, our community or company, the Community Crisis Management (CCM) team works to coordinate a swift and effective response across the company to mitigate any continued damage. The team is responsible and accountable for immediate decisions, managing the cross-functional response to severe safety crises on the platform, keeping Airbnb leadership properly informed and involved, and for alerting relevant team leaders to any root causes or vulnerabilities that may have been uncovered throughout the response.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a Community Crisis Investigator, you carry your own caseload and run the day-to-day response, with a defined check-in point for the calls that set precedent or carry external exposure. You assess incidents and bring what you learn back to the team.
A Typical Day:
Crisis Case Work
Assess incoming incidents and recommend whether a case meets the threshold for crisis implementation, drafting summaries concise and comprehensive enough that the decision-maker can act on them without sending them back.
Outline and drive the case management actions needed for stakeholders to respond effectively, keeping the response moving inside the incident’s timeline.
Research case precedent and consult stakeholders when a case does not fit an established pattern, and bring your recommended option with its reasoning rather than an open question.
Prepare concise overviews and next steps for urgent, monitoring, or implemented cases, and note team updates or housekeeping items during regional check-ins.
Communication and Stakeholder Management
Draft crisis case communication for senior stakeholders, and supply the case detail and assessment that executive notifications are built from.
Keep stakeholders and GCM (Global Crisis Management) leadership current on case status proactively, before they ask.
Hold day-to-day communication with your assigned cross-functional partners: maintain regular contact, come prepared to the agenda, and bring what you learn back to the global GCM team.
Systemic Improvement
Flag where policy, product, or process failed the community member, with enough specificity that the owning team can act. The goal is closing the gap that allowed the incident, not only resolving the incident.
Keep the case management tool accurate for your own cases and raise data or backlog problems you notice, so the team’s view of the global caseload stays trustworthy.
Team Contribution
Review peers’ assessments as a second pair of eyes before submission, checking for errors, missing stakeholders, and recommendations worth adding.
Share what you learn from your cases and stakeholder relationships with the team.
Contribute to team culture and to a working environment where people can do this work sustainably.
Operational Rigor
Maintain case documentation and trackers to a standard that supports accurate analytics and clean handoffs within and across regions.
Complete work within the dedicated SLAs, and raise it early when a case is at risk of slipping rather than after it has.

Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base works in the physical world. A homeowner finds us and decides to trust a new kind of power company. A crew installs the battery. The city approves it, the utility connects it, and we dispatch it, telling it when to charge and when to send power back based on local grid conditions and the member’s usage. Our software has to work inside every one of those steps.

Now we’re going nationwide, and every new state is a new puzzle. The utilities and grids are different. Cities have their own rules. Homeowners think about batteries very differently, too: someone in Houston who lived through a week-long outage sees a home battery differently than someone who has never lost power. Launching a market means learning all of that fast, building software that works there, and then doing it again in the next state.

We’re hiring a forward deployed engineer to go where those problems are.



How this role works

You’ll embed with the teams and partners behind each launch and learn how their operations really run. Then you’ll build whatever it takes to make the launch work, from a partner’s spreadsheet to BaseOS to the firmware on the battery. What you learn goes back to our Core Experience and Platform teams, so every launch makes the system better.



Where you might embed

 - Growth: our sales and marketing teams and the partners who bring homeowners to Base, like homebuilders and channel partners. Build what each new market needs to launch, and scale what works from state to state.

 - Deployments: our deployments team and installer partners. Get new crews, paperwork rules, and handoffs right in every state.

 - Utilities: our utility and markets team and the utilities we connect to. Use grid data to find where the grid is strained, decide where batteries do the most good, and shape how we dispatch the fleet.



What you’ll do

 - Learn how the work really gets done, and where it breaks, by working alongside the team or partner

 - Help decide which problems matter most, what to build, and what to fix with process instead of code

 - Build end-to-end software: integrations, internal tools, workflows, data pipelines, and partner-facing products

 - Ship a prototype fast, then harden what works so other teams can rely on it

 - Work with utility partners on grid constraints and data, and build tools that turn that data into decisions about where to deploy batteries and how to command them

 - Launch new states by standing up the partner integrations, workflows, and data each market needs, and make the next launch faster



What you’ll bring

 - 2+ years building production software in product or full-stack engineering roles

 - Strong frontend and full-stack skills, with comfort across modern web apps, APIs, data models, and stateful user experiences

 - Strong product judgment and a track record of turning ambiguous ideas into shipped, useful products

 - Experience in 0-to-1 or fast-moving environments where user needs, product shape, and success metrics are still changing

 - Experience using product analytics, experimentation, and data to guide decisions

 - Intensity and urgency, and a high bar for your own work



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

description:
About Flexport:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
Your Launchpad into Global Trade
The opportunity
As a Customs Specialist, you won't just be starting a job; you'll be starting a career at the heart of international trade. You'll join our core Customs team—a product poised for more than 10x growth in the next five years—and play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world.
You'll be on the front lines, working with clients, shippers, and government agencies to clear goods across international borders. Forget old-school logistics; here, you'll use Flexport's state-of-the-art technology to automate processes and set new industry standards. You’ll be surrounded by industry leaders in a vibrant, supportive environment that’s built on teamwork and innovation. We invest in our people with continuous learning opportunities to help you grow into a thought leader in the customs field.
What you’ll do
Become a global trade expert by navigating the complex world of customs regulations to ensure goods comply with international laws.
Keep supply chains moving by managing the essential documents and data needed for smooth customs clearance to CBP.
Build your client management skills by collaborating with international clients and logistics partners, providing them with timely information and support.
Drive innovation by using Flexport's technology to optimize customs processes and provide data to clients.
Sharpen your strategic thinking by participating in client business reviews and operational calls, gaining direct exposure to high-level strategy.
Embrace continuous improvement by following—and helping us improve—our standard operating procedures to make our work even smarter.
This role is for you if you…
Recently earned a Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
Have a "compliance-first" mindset, with a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and regulatory adherence
Are a natural problem-solver who pays close attention to the details.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment, can adapt to new technology, and aren't afraid of a tight deadline.
Are a master of organization who can prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks with minimal supervision.
Are an excellent communicator (both verbal and written) who seeks out and welcomes feedback to grow.
Why you’ll love working at Flexport
Make a Real-World Impact: Your work will directly help companies—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—navigate the complexities of global trade.
Unmatched Career Growth: We're committed to your development. With mentorship from industry experts and continuous learning opportunities, you'll have the resources to build a meaningful career.
Comprehensive Benefits: We offer a competitive salary with equity, giving you a real stake in our success. Enjoy flexible paid vacation and sick days so you can take the time you need to rest and recharge and a generous benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, and more.

Go-to-Market Excellence: Develop and implement comprehensive go-to-market plans, including pricing strategies and sales policies designed to achieve revenue and margin targets.
Market Intelligence & VOC: Coordinate Voice of the Customer (VOC) exercises to define regional and global requirements for new product launches.
Technical & Channel Partnership: The Product Manager develops enough technical expertise to accurately interpret customer challenges, translate them into actionable technical requirements, and then communicate solutions back to commercial audiences.

Data Proficiency: A strong preference for data-driven decision-makers; experience with Power BI, HubSpot CRM, and ERP systems.
Commercial Savvy: A passion for technology and innovation with a proven, quantifiable track record of launching products and analyzing segmented P&L statements to impact the financial success of a product line.
Leadership Instincts: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative leadership style and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

You will join a dynamic and diverse team in a professional office setting. This role requires the ability to travel up to 15–20% domestically, ranging from day trips to week-long excursions depending on the product lifecycle.

At ITW, we offer a professional environment where your decisions directly affect the financial success of the product line. title: Clinical Applications Engineer
description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
*In order to be considered for the role, candidates must reside in Columbus, Cleveland, Cincinnati, OH or Detroit, MI.*
Primary Function of Position
The Clinical Applications Engineer (CAE) reports to the Manager of Clinical Applications Engineering. The
CAE plays a critical role in the early adoption of new technology, expanding access to robotic minimally
invasive care. This individual will be primarily focused on building and supporting early users through their
system learning curve and provide technical expertise on the system as applicable during clinical
procedures. They will play a crucial role in transitioning users from their initial training to proficiency with
the system and its use. They will also be responsible for providing guidance and perspective to design
engineering about system usage nuances within the market they serve.
Essential Job Duties
• Provide procedural support to new robotic system sites to promote safety and effective
progression
• Collaborate with global Clinical Applications Engineering and Endoluminal Sales to support new
users through their early learning curve
• Provide expert clinical product and technical assistance and training to physicians and clinical
staff on the effective use of Intuitive’s equipment during clinical procedures
• Identify key areas of concern for clinical users for procedure adoption and collaborate with
training and development partners to evaluate and address them
• Drive collaboration and maintain consistent, open lines of communication across the assigned
responsibilities with the global Clinical Applications Engineering team as well as the development
teams.
• Collaborate with peers and development engineering partners to develop and share best
practices and product feedback
• Stay current on company products instructions for use (IFU), best practices and technical
troubleshooting, as well as relevant scientific clinical literature and new product information
• Prioritize and appropriately respond to requests in a high-stress
environment.
Required Skills and Experience
• A minimum of 2 years of technical or clinical experience in healthcare
• Experience navigating hospitals and supporting procedures required
• Self-starter who performs well with autonomy and can be flexible in a dynamic work
environment
• Problem solver who can maintain composure and think critically in high pressure environments
• Highly collaborative and works well in a remote team environment
• Effective communication skills including oral, written and interpersonal. Strong situational
awareness
• Experience working with highly complex technical systems and/or working in a critical patient
care setting with physicians and support staff
• Ability to seek out and process large amounts of data to translate information into actionable
insights
• Desire to learn and build new skills
• Ability to travel up to 70%, located near a major airline/rail hub, and ability to work nights and
weekends as needed
• Ability to independently prioritize and manage travel logistics, and complete associated
administrative tasks in a timely manner
• Ability to travel on a moment’s notice and support cases across varying geographies; comfortable
booking and utilizing all forms of travel
Required Education and Training
• Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering or in healthcare-based field

Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and business-to-technical translation.

Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools for report validation and basic analysis.

We are seeking a Staff Electrical Engineer to join the Advanced Product Development (APD) research and development team at Intuitive Surgical. In this role you will be responsible for both embedded architecture definition, motor control systems and the design and implementation of high-speed compute platform PCAs. As a Staff Electrical Engineer, you will work with a small multidisciplinary start-up-like team chartered with inventing the future of computer-augmented robotic surgery. You will be involved in delivering features by integrating complex functionality into complete surgical robot solutions, and seeing these through verification, validation and product release.
The successful candidate must excel in a high-energy focused small-team environment, be able to drive to solutions from rough requirements, and have a commitment to high product quality. Quick learning and a desire to deeply understand requirements, develop high-fidelity prototypes, and rapidly iterate are essential. A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the desire to make work fun, collaborative, and interesting. Supporting you will be a development and management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and is a partner in your continued career development and success.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Design, bring-up, and integration of custom printed circuit assemblies (PCAs).
Architect communication, processing, and distribution of electronic subsystems across the product. Challenge the status quo architecture to propose alternate, efficient and latest tech stacks,
Collaborate on system design and architecture with other Advanced Development engineering team members, including FPGA logic design, mechanical, software and controls.
Identify and implement key components in actuation of robotic systems (e.g. position and motion sensing, vision, embedded display and UI, and the driving of brushed and brushless DC motors).
Implement PCB designs that balance performance, cost, and manufacturability.

Lineage, Reconciliation & Root-Cause Analysis: Analyze end-to-end processes and data flows across ERP (SAP), CRM, billing, data warehouse, and reporting platforms. Use advanced SQL and analytical tools to reconcile data, validate business rules, investigate discrepancies, and identify root causes.

Internal Controls & Quality Monitoring: Support automated monitoring, exception management, data-quality controls, and financially significant/SOX-governed reporting processes.
Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Collaborate with application, Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, and platform teams while coordinating and reviewing deliverables across distributed onsite and offshore resources.
Applied AI & Automation Evaluation: Evaluate and support opportunities to implement intelligent alerts, natural-language analytics, AI-assisted analysis, and workflow automation within core Finance processes.

7+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, Finance analytics, reporting, business systems analysis, or enterprise data solutions.

Advanced SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills for complex querying, source-to-target reconciliation, data troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and query performance optimization.
Enterprise BI Platforms: Strong hands-on experience designing dashboards, BI data models, calculated metrics, published data sources, and self-service solutions in Tableau , Power BI , or a comparable enterprise analytics platform.

Experience coordinating and reviewing work with distributed onsite and offshore analysts or consultants.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.

title: Sr Product Mgr, Global Svc Offerings
description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
At Intuitive, the needs of our customers are a key driver in our approach to service innovation. Within Global Services Product Management, we build deep understanding of customer needs by working closely with them to assess strengths and opportunities. We incorporate these insights into our Global Service offerings, capabilities, and digital service solutions.
The Senior Product Manager, Global Service Offerings will play a role in Global Services innovation by defining and executing Global Service offering strategy, pricing, portfolio alignment, market research, performance analytics, and commercialization. This role will focus on the day-to-day execution and evolution of our global service offering strategy, ensuring offerings deliver measurable value for customers while supporting company growth objectives. This role will partner across regions and functions—working with Service Operations, Sales, Marketing, Contracts, Finance, and Product—to design, launch, and optimize service offerings that align with customer needs, improve outcomes, and complement our medical device portfolio.
This is a high-visibility role and directly influences recurring revenue, customer satisfaction, and the long-term success of our service business. The Senior Product Manager will develop solution roadmaps and continuously iterate on those roadmaps based on user feedback, emerging customer and service team needs, and business objectives.
Responsibilities for this role include both upstream and downstream activities. Upstream, the Senior Product Manager will create proposals to enhance or develop new service capabilities, draft business cases to support those proposals, and define requirements for delivery. Downstream, they will consult on end-user training curriculum and marketing opportunities as a subject matter expert on the customer experience and program services.
The Senior Product Manager will have an understanding of the Global Services technology, Intuitive products, and associated capabilities. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to goals set forth by Global Services Leadership and product business units.
Essential Job Duties
Manage the lifecycle of global service contract offerings—from design and pricing to launch, performance monitoring, and retirement.
Translate customer insights, market research, and product roadmaps into clear service offerings that align to customer outcomes and business goals.
Develop business cases to support service solution proposals that demonstrate the desirability, viability, and feasibility for the proposed solution. Use proposals to secure support and funding from relevant stakeholders and leadership.
Define value propositions that are simple, differentiated, and complementary to our medical device and digital solutions portfolio.
Manage a suite of internal and external service value tools.
Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to develop pricing and offering models based on market intelligence and economic analysis.
Monitor KPIs (renewals, upgrades, margin, adoption, value realization) and use insights to refine strategy.
Ensure offerings deliver measurable, outcomes-based value to customers and align to contract frameworks.
Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders (Sales, Pricing, Marketing, Contracts, Service Ops, Legal) to launch and scale offerings effectively.
Support Marketing’s efforts to create enablement materials (service collateral, readiness guides, tender support) and train teams to ensure successful adoption.
Support contract renewals and subscription processes to drive recurring revenue growth.
Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Service Delivery teams to incorporate evolving support requirements into service offerings and contracts.
Partner with Customer Success, Field Service Engineering, Technical Support, Business Systems, and Digital Services to ensure operational readiness and quality of delivery.
Act as a connector and subject matter expert across global teams, ensuring alignment on strategy, execution, and outcomes.
Establish and track key performance metrics, using dashboards and analytics to measure success and identify opportunities.
Conduct competitive and market analyses to guide evolution of service strategy.
Capture and synthesize customer feedback to inform future offerings and continuous improvement.
Develop and track goals for identified priorities. Ensure goals are aligned to business unit goals and corporate objectives.
Engage in conferences, customer visits, job shadowing, and other relevant activities to build and maintain subject matter expertise and familiarity with Global Services, customer needs, and strategic opportunities.
Perform other aligned duties as specified by Global Services Leadership
Required Skills and Experience
Minimum 8 years professional experience in product management, portfolio management, service management in healthcare, medical device, or equivalent role
Demonstrated success designing and managing global service offerings/contracts, or similar offerings, including pricing, GTM execution, and lifecycle management
Experience with subscription/recurring revenue models, contract renewals, or tender processes
Strong financial and analytical acumen, with proven track record of data-driven decisions
Strong track record of leading strategic initiatives from concept through to completion
Experience building business cases, using qualitative and quantitative data, to secure funding, resources, project/program support, and contribute to budget planning/negotiations
Excellent collaboration and influencing skills; proven ability to work effectively in a highly cross-functional, matrixed global environment.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to develop and present impactful presentations on complex topics for cross-functional audiences (internal and external), director/VP-level leadership, and global stakeholders
Strong results orientation, organizational skills, and project management skills; able to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives and deadlines with attention to detail
Experience investigating and defining complex problems prior to solution development
Experience with market research, voice of customer feedback, voice of service feedback, or equivalent
Self-directed with awareness to proactively seek advice when needed
Strong knowledge of the MS Office product suite
Knowledge of medical device service operations or healthcare systems is a plus.
Experience with SFDC and tableau is a plus.
Required Education and Training
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in a related field required
Working Conditions
None
Preferred Skills and Experience
MBA preferred

description:

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
Contribute your technical skills to design and develop manufacturing equipment for the Multiport Accessories Process Engineering organization, with a focus on high-volume automation. The candidate will take responsibility for equipment development from initial concept and detailed mechanical design through fabrication, testing, qualification, and release to production.
The candidate will design and develop in-house proprietary manufacturing equipment and will also evaluate external automation suppliers, define detailed equipment specifications, and provide technical oversight to OEMs. The candidate must demonstrate strong mechanical design fundamentals, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to coordinate within cross-functional teams. They must excel in a high-energy environment and be capable of making sound decisions when faced with time constraints and incomplete information.
Essential Job Duties
Design and develop in-house manufacturing equipment, automation systems, tooling, and fixtures from concept through release to production.
Translate manufacturing process needs into detailed equipment requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria.
Develop 3D models, engineering drawings, tolerance analyses, bills of material, and supporting technical documentation.
Integrate mechanical designs with robotics, sensors, motors, pneumatics, motion control, machine vision, and safety systems.
Evaluate and select OEMs and system integrators based on technical capabilities and project requirements.
Develop detailed specifications for externally sourced automation equipment and provide technical oversight through design, build, testing, installation, and qualification.
Lead equipment design reviews, risk assessments, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving activities.
Guide equipment projects through applicable design control, engineering change, qualification, and release processes.
Develop equipment testing strategies, acceptance criteria, qualification protocols, maintenance requirements, and calibration procedures.
Apply Cpk, Gauge R&R, tolerance analysis, and other statistical and quality tools to improve equipment capability and reliability.
Provide equipment-related technical support for production operations, continuous improvement, capacity expansion, and equipment lifecycle management.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, technicians, and cross-functional project team members.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience with high volume automation lines.
Fundamental understanding of process engineering, equipment, test and the manufacturing environment “Self-starter” attitude and comfort in a hands-on environment, where he/she can demonstrate an ability to work with other engineers to influence product design to improve reliability
Demonstrated experience designing and releasing manufacturing equipment or complex automated systems into production.
Proficiency in 3D CAD and engineering drawing development. SolidWorks experience is preferred.
Strong understanding of mechanical design, mechanism development, GD&T, tolerance analysis, material selection, and manufacturing processes.
Ability to integrate mechatronic components such as robotics, sensors, motors, pneumatics, motion control, and machine vision systems.
Experience developing equipment requirements and detailed technical specifications for automation OEMs or system integrators.
Experience reviewing supplier concepts, designs, drawings, component selections, and equipment acceptance plans.
Experience with equipment qualification, process validation, and regulated quality systems.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, project execution, and technical documentation skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Self-motivated, able to take initiative, and effective in a multidisciplinary team environment.
Required Education and Training
BS/MS degree in Mechanical engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum of eight years of relevant experience developing manufacturing equipment or automation systems.
Direct experience in medical device manufacturing is required.
Staff-level consideration will require additional technical depth and demonstrated leadership of complex equipment or automation projects.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Experience in an ISO 13485 regulated medical device manufacturing environment.
Experience designing equipment for high-volume assembly of medical devices or precision products.
Experience managing internally designed equipment and externally sourced turnkey automation systems.
Experience with OEM selection, technical bid evaluation, design reviews, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, and production qualification.
Familiarity with design controls, risk management, engineering change control, and equipment validation.
Experience with Windchill and Agile product lifecycle management systems is a strong plus.
Experience mentoring engineers or establishing equipment design standards and engineering best practices.

Reality

Take extreme ownership from planning through adoption, ensuring solutions go live smoothly and deliver sustained value.
Post-Go-Live Digital Relationship Management: Support post-go-live digital solution adoption through intervention to protect customer confidence and long-term successful utilization of digital solutions.
Leadership
Elevate Digital Product Feedback: Develop and maintain a deep technical understanding of Intuitive’s digital portfolio and proactively synthesize and relay field learnings and customer feedback to leadership to influence roadmap direction, remove systemic barriers, and accelerate value realization across accounts.
Continuous Improvement / Creativity
Continuously Grow Technical and Strategic Capability: Identify personal skill gaps, self-development, and take ownership of pursuing ongoing learning in relevant technologies, project leadership, and stakeholder management. Contribute to team-wide growth by sharing best practices and elevating performance through example.
Required Skills and Experience
6+ years of experience in medical technology implementation, IT consulting, or digital within healthcare
Deep understanding of cloud-hosted SaaS platforms, healthcare data security, and networking infrastructure
Experience with account management or direct collaboration with capital sales
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with all levels of stakeholders – operational, clinical, and technical
Required Education and Training
Bachelor’s Degree
Working Conditions
Comfortable working a flexible dynamic schedule.
Remote work
Able to travel up to 25%.

description:

Job Description
Position Overview
As the Compliance Manager, Asset Management, you will be responsible for leading a team with ownership for Prevailing Wage & Apprenticeship (PWA) compliance across Invenergy’s operating portfolio. The Manager role will be heavily focused on leading a team of 1-2 associates to drive compliance milestones and deliverables, ensuring information integrity, ensuring processes within the department follow company standards, establishing new processes where they do not exist, and leading key initiatives. This is a highly visible role requiring clear communication, curiosity, organization, and strong coordination across multiple facets of the organization—including Asset Management, Operations, Human Resources, Tax, Legal, and Procurement, among others.
General Responsibilities:
Lead PWA compliance initiatives for a portfolio of operations projects, ensuring project deliverables are met to the required scope and schedule.
Lead team members to manage project deliverables across multiple contractors and scopes to ensure adherence to project schedule.
Represent the company in discussions with stakeholders, third party consultants and the projects customer/owner.
Escalate project and portfolio roadblocks to senior leadership; work with direct reports to remove identified roadblocks to maintain project scope, budget and schedule.
Specific Responsibilities :
Manage the collection of wage reports from contractors across the portfolio of operating projects and facilitate the review by outside consultants, ensuring the timely completion to deliver the required reports and certificates before project deadlines and minimizing penalties.
Track the timely completion and documentation of cure and penalty payments.
Draft, submit, defend, and negotiate wage determination submissions. Track the project-specific contract effective dates and required wage determination renewals. Provide inputs to economic analyses based on wage rates.
Support the tax and finance team with the preparation of PWA-related forms for annual tax filings.
Manage consultant relationships, invoicing, and allocation of costs to the projects.
Establish and lead regular portfolio and project meetings and status updates to ensure compliance deliverables are met.
Develop and improve upon first-of-a-kind compliance processes and associated procedures with an emphasis on accuracy and scalability. Drive the implementation of best practices and lessons learned.
Review regulations, rules, and contracts governing PWA-related items to interpret requirements and translate them into business processes.
Provide internal training and support regarding compliance requirements and best practices. Serve as the subject matter expert on PWA compliance related topics. Provide training and support to clients and contractors.
Ensure records are adequately kept and sensitive or confidential information is managed per company document management policies.
Evaluate contracts and proposals for appropriate compliance language; provide edits and feedback to internal stakeholders, third party consultants and contractors as needed to support compliance goals.
Onboard new construction and repower projects as they enter into PW operations, and maintain a forecast of upcoming projects.
Other duties as may be assigned to support Asset Management, Procurement, and Operations Support.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
7+ years of related experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to apply structure and judgment to complex issues.
Strong oral and written communication skills – able to communicate clearly, concisely, and persuasively with tact and diplomacy.
Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent organizational abilities.
In-depth understanding of federal, state, and local regulations related to prevailing wage, apprenticeship programs, Davis-Bacon Act, and local requirements.
Prior experience managing a team.
Proficient in document control systems and auditing methodologies.
Familiarity with underlying data systems that generate PWA-related data.
Excellent solution-seeking, teamwork, collaboration, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ownership mindset and sound professional judgment, with a track record of driving continuous improvement, process enhancement, and disciplined execution.
Highly organized and strategic thinker, capable of prioritizing competing demands.
Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision, while effectively collaborating across functions in a fast‑paced, entrepreneurial environment.

title: Processor 1
location: HPC - Jacksonville Factory, Florida, United States of America
description:
Job Purpose
To ensure we are supplying customers with the highest quality products while adhering to all food and safety standards. This is accomplished by batching food product/condiments to corporate/customer approved recipes.
Essential Functions & Responsibilities
• Obtains instruction from lead processor or supervisor.
• Ability to follow complete production schedules with minimal scrap/spoilage
• Keep up with volume of work required
• Visually inspects equipment at station for cleanliness or obvious maintenance problems.
• Cleans small machine components, as needed.
• Reports any problems to lead processor or supervisor.
• Makes piping connections as needed for particular process on schedule.
• Monitors equipment controls, temperature meters, valves and adjusts as needed.
• Operates forklift/pallet jack to obtain ingredients or move pallets/totes in and around processing area.
• While slow, assists processing assistants in cleaning processing areas by scrubbing walls, hosing floor, sweeping floor/emptying trash and performing other cleaning duties.
• Utilizes can openers, knives, band cutters, snips, pliers and other small items to open ingredient cases/packages.
• Maintains neat work area. Wipes spills that have occurred during mixing process.
• Records data pertaining to work completed, ingredients used, lot codes and other processing information.
• Assists in cleaning equipment and lines between recipes.
• Very occasionally obtains ingredients/supplies from warehouse.
• Obtains samples of batches and taste test.
• Asks lead, supervisor or material handler if there is any rework.
• Uses rework if there is any consistently.
• Determines ingredients required for formula/recipe and the required amount.
• Ability to safely lift 50lbs on a regular basis.
• Obtains ingredients from storage area or around work area and pours into kettle.
• Meters in other ingredients as required by watching meters and turning on/off kettle.
• Utilizes drum lift by strapping drum into lift and operating hydraulic lift with chain.
• Manually pushes drum lift to kettle and dumps drum of ingredients as needed.
• Operates controls to activate mixers and equipment.
• Monitors controls, equipment temperature, valves, and adjusts equipment to meet formula requirements.
• Hoses spills off floor and hoses towards drains.
• Obtains, measures and weighs additional ingredients to set aside in preparation for next batch or recipe.
• Assists other processors in pouring ingredients into kettles as needed.
• Collects samples and tests for pH, acidity, viscosity and solids.
• Reads test results and adjusts equipment/recipe accordingly.
• Notifies lead processor of any major adjustments needed, or problems with process.
• Transfers finished products to drum, tote, or tank by pumping through piping system.
• Operates switches to control pumps when batch is complete.
• Assists in preparing drums, totes, or tanks for storage of product by ensuring that the proper placarding information is on the package.
• Determines appropriate size of batch needed to accommodate orders and line.
• Closely monitors batch temperature while processing and waiting for packaging to ensure that product will not set prematurely.
• Operates equipment in a safe manner following GMP guidelines and keeps work area clean.
• Supports the Jacksonville plant FSQ and QRMP initiatives on any and all procedures/programs pertaining to product safety.
• Participates in meetings and have scheduling flexibility.
• Trains others as necessary.
• Fills in for other positions as necessary.
• Occasionally testing batches in the lab and recording information on proper documentation.
• Additional responsibilities of this position include assisting in the creation of a culture of safety and health by performing work safely in accordance with all company safety procedures.
• Operates equipment safely and reports any unsafe work conditions or practice to supervisor. Occupational safety and health performance is measured in this position
• Other duties as assigned
